'''Grembae's son''' was a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] of the [[Yedagon Confederacy]]. He made delta-shaped wedges on [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] helmet as a decorative motif before the [[Adumari Civil War]].<ref name="Starfighters of Adumar" />

He was on the same team as his [[Grembae|mother]], who was also a mechanic.<ref name="Starfighters of Adumar" />
